name: popsicle
headline: CuriousME: Q&A Platform with Admin Controls
short_description: A QnA(Question- Answer) platform where  moderators of the platform will post unique questions and users can answer them./Moderator adds questions related to different categories such as startups, Investments, Business, Marketing, Strategy, Common topics of interest, or trending topics) and add keywords under the questions. Users log in and answer interesting questions that are appealing to them . Admin can manage users  & content of the platform.
author: saturn-vipul

sections.overview:
CuriousME is a Q&A platform that connects users with curated questions posted by sub-administrators across various categories. The platform enables users to log in and answer questions that match their interests, while sub-admins handle content moderation, spam prevention, and category management. Administrators have full control over user management and platform content. The system supports structured question organization with categories, making it easy for users to find relevant topics to engage with.
Community engagement around business and investment topics
User-generated knowledge base with moderated Q&A content
Multi-category discussion platform with administrative oversight
Spam prevention and content moderation in community forums
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/saturn-vipul/CuriousME`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a moderator for CuriousME. Create an engaging question for the 'Marketing' category. The question should be relevant to [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Include 3-5 relevant keywords for SEO. Format the question to encourage thoughtful responses from users.
```
Copy

```
# Question for CuriousME

**Category:** Marketing
**Keywords:** digital marketing, brand awareness, social media strategy, content creation, target audience

**Question:** How can [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business, effectively leverage digital marketing to increase brand awareness among millennials? What specific social media platforms and content strategies would you recommend to engage this target audience?

Please share your insights and experiences in the comments below.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
